$comment: Business purpose: Reads the project Git Service diff with optional path, revision, staged, stat_only, and unified context filters. Technical description: Validates structured git_diff arguments for all roles and explorer subagents.
title: Forge Git diff tool input

paths.description: Optional project-relative file or directory paths to scope git_diff.

base.description: Optional base revision or branch to diff from.

head.description: Optional head revision or branch to diff against base.

staged.description: When true, inspects staged index changes (--cached).

stat_only.description: When true, returns only --stat summary to avoid large diff payloads.

unified.description: Number of unified diff context lines (0..20).
